cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(Demo LANGUAGES C CXX)

# Configure cache-backed options for the demo target.
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20 CACHE STRING "C++ standard")
set(DEMO_SOURCES src/demo.cpp src/lib.cpp)

add_library(demo STATIC ${DEMO_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(demo PRIVATE include)

function(configure_demo target_name)
  if(TARGET ${target_name})
    message(STATUS "Configuring ${target_name}")
  endif()
endfunction()

configure_demo(demo)
